prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently under medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured is represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them as well.

We request that you provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dash camera data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any electronic records. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our client's claim and of the need to preserve all relevant materials.
